title: We really enjoyed this show.  The...
text: We really enjoyed this show. The dancers were amazing. The food was very nice. The 'cave' was beautiful and romantic and the service was really good. The hop-on Hop-off train is a great way to see the city if you don't have time to walk around it. We would recommend this.
author: Rachael N
